objective_for_doctor:
Age: 51
Sex: F
Chief Complaint: pain

turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
Pain in my stomach that burns and can go up into my throat, sometimes with a bitter taste in my mouth—plus a cough. My symptoms get worse after eating.
How long have you been experiencing these symptoms?
Have you noticed any difficulty swallowing, unintentional weight loss, vomiting, or black/tarry stools?
Do your symptoms tend to worsen when you lie down or at night?
I don’t know. But my symptoms do get worse after eating, and it’s a burning sensation that starts in my stomach and goes up into my throat.
Have you tried taking antacids or acid-reducing medications for this, and if so, do they relieve your symptoms?
I don’t know. But I have a burning sensation that starts in my stomach and goes up into my throat, and it can be associated with a bitter taste in my mouth. My symptoms get worse after eating.
[DDX] Gastroesophageal reflux disease, Laryngopharyngeal reflux, Peptic ulcer disease, Hiatal hernia, Functional dyspepsia
